round_comparison: same source split, same seeds, same exogenous schedules, same BT gate and execution proxy
scope: 2 to 5 ordered local navigation stages, frozen observed UC maps and calibrated execution proxy; not complete RMUC matches or live Nav2 training
limits: Source snapshots share one engineering spawn neighborhood.
No economy, posture, combat, aiming, firing, opponents or official region registration.
Support/latency/stall randomization ranges are engineering assumptions, not measured probability estimates.
Successful safe waiting is reported separately from navigation success.
